proposal.reason: Main change is host-side runtime enqueue behavior: graphUsageMode is validated/configured and then used in strong-stream acquire/release and capture handling, changing graph/uncaptured mixing semantics during work upload and stream coordination. Additional device-topology review is needed because P2P channel count selection now depends on nChannelsPerNetPeer/maxP2pPeers and updates topology-derived per-peer channel computation and tuning logic.
